neighbours.label: The word that completes a fixed phrase ('used interchangeably', 'all year round', 'is prime')
fire: The two terms are often used interchangeably in daily speech.
The shop is open all year round except on holidays.
Counting up, five is prime and six is not.
Both labels can be applied almost interchangeably in this field.
The pond stays frozen all year round at that altitude.
In math class we learned that seven is prime.
Doctors use these words interchangeably when talking to patients.
Tourists visit the resort all year round.
quiet: The two terms are often defined separately in daily speech.
The shop is open every day except on holidays.
Counting up, five is odd and six is even.
Both labels can be applied only in this field.
The pond stays frozen for months at that altitude.
In math class we learned that seven is odd.
Doctors use these words differently when talking to patients.
Tourists visit the resort during the summer.

notes: triage: unclear then probed. probe: interchangeably 0.73, is prime 0.40, round 0.13; cat/white <0.03.
